evidence.locator: 1500 x 1500 px over 1.25 × 1.25 arcmin; WFPC2 He II 469, [O III] 502, H-alpha 656 and [N II] 658 nm; released 24 January 2000. The file's embedded sky tags for scale and direction, 0.0499 arcsec per pixel and north 168.4° left of vertical, and the central star for place: the tags alone put the star 0.45 arcsec from where the picture shows it, so the frame's centre is set at 112.2952649°, 20.9119113°, where the star in the picture is at its Gaia place.
